items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: somebody told me Tony Jackson used to play.

ctx.x: Yeah, because Paul Dufresher, of course, he died. He was the only gamekeeper down there. I don't know if he did anything with his money. He bought several pieces of property there. Oh, it'll fill after you. Yeah. So that's extremely well fixed. The rest of them, they made a whole lot of money and they spent it just like they made it big time.

Well, there's just one little corner there of the old district that's left the place, around the corner where Lula's had a saloon. I guess it was a bar room next to Lula. Yes. That building's still there. I see. And then the one back, a couple little crib places. And then the one at the corner, somebody told me Tony Jackson used to play.
